NONE were green at parking, so nothing was left unsubmitted.

TWO TICKETS ARE MERGED BUT NOT CLOSED, and both blockers are known:
  4329 - its blocking AC2 is now satisfied (2083 merged, evidence recorded as a comment). A close was attempted at parking; result unknown. Just retry 'rebar transition 4329-4761-6e3d-41d7 in_progress closed'.
  7931 - blocked ONLY by the attestation signing race, bug a83f-6348-a08c-401d (store-read-failure on every sign-review; the verdict itself is PASS). Its ACs are all ticked and verified. Retry sign-review when store contention is low, then close. Do NOT force.

WHAT I STOPPED: 14 subagents, all killed mid-flight. Their Gerrit changes and worktrees persist, so no work is lost - resume by re-dispatching against /Users/joeoakhart/.claude/jobs/e50ec61e/tmp/LEAF_BRIEF.md and telling each agent its change number from the list above. Worktrees: /Users/joeoakhart/impl-<4hex>/ per leaf. 73b8's agent had just found a REAL problem worth resuming into: the 20s enrich-drain budget genuinely fires, and it was measuring which tests exceed it.

THREE EPIC ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA NEED A HUMAN DECISION (all evidence already recorded as epic comments, none acted on unilaterally): AC3 net-negative lines is at +241 across 8 of 13 consolidation children and will not converge; AC2 additions-only-in-tests is violated by 25b4 and 6f18 for legitimate reasons; and the epic still says 'fourteen' consolidation children when there are thirteen.
